prototypes.title: Activity-shape portfolio
prototypes.problem: The existing sample posts repeat one reflective structure.
prototypes.new_structure: Ten activity shapes cover process, route, mission, clue, observation, research, detail, lab, multi-day and verification content.
prototypes.visual_rule: Reuse the existing carousel, collection row and Fluent feed.
prototypes.evidence_rule: Original copy and attributed local media only; omit unsupported facts.
prototypes.existing_comparison: Replaces only MockStudyCommunityData; live API and fallback boundary remain unchanged.

prototypes.title: Route purpose card
prototypes.problem: Place-only routes are difficult to use as learning plans.
prototypes.new_structure: Each stage states an observation action and a compact takeaway.
prototypes.visual_rule: Use the existing stage timeline and avoid a new dashboard.
prototypes.evidence_rule: Do not invent venue schedules, fees or booking details.
prototypes.existing_comparison: Merged into stages, post copy and curation notes.

prototypes.title: Evidence-linked field task
prototypes.problem: Many field photos do not retain a retrievable question.
prototypes.new_structure: Clue, observation and task structures connect questions to media.
prototypes.visual_rule: Use existing rich text headings, bullets and media pager.
prototypes.evidence_rule: Describe unknowns and omit unverified identities or conclusions.
prototypes.existing_comparison: Configures approved task, exhibit and observation patterns without new screens.

prototypes.title: Four curated learning shelves
prototypes.problem: A larger feed still needs low-effort grouping.
prototypes.new_structure: Four activity-oriented collections organize the sample portfolio.
prototypes.visual_rule: Reuse the compact horizontal collection strip.
prototypes.evidence_rule: Counts are sample counts, not live analytics.
prototypes.existing_comparison: Expands the existing collection fallback from three to four shelves.

prototypes.title: Copied social-media shell
prototypes.problem: Social-media imitation can add noise and rights risk.
prototypes.visual_rule: Keep ZhiWuBen Fluent tokens and original components.
prototypes.evidence_rule: Proprietary screenshots, author copy and brand assets cannot ship.

findings: licensed local media and attribution verified
